englishTranslation: Pho with rare beef and brisket
atAGlance: Phở tái nạm gives you two beef textures in one bowl: tender rare beef and richer brisket. It is still a clean broth dish, but the meat feels fuller than plain phở tái.
whatItIs: Phở tái nạm combines rare beef with brisket in the same bowl. The rare beef stays tender, while nạm brings a deeper beef flavor and more chew.
howToEnjoy: Taste both beef cuts before changing the broth. Add lime or chili only after you know how rich the brisket makes the bowl.
howLocalsOrder: Phở tái nạm is the order when you want rare beef, so say the full name instead of just phở. Add lime, herbs, and chili after tasting the beef broth; ask for cooked beef instead if rare beef is not for you.
worthKnowing: Tái nạm combines rare beef with brisket or flank, a classic phở-shop move for people who want both tenderness and deeper beef flavor.
goodToKnow: Nạm is brisket, so this bowl has more chew and beef depth. Taste the broth before adding chili sauce or lime.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một tô phở tái nạm.
orderLine.english: I’d like one bowl of pho with rare beef and brisket.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht toh fuh tie nahm
